models.original_prompt:
Build an endless runner in Tron visual style.
3 lanes, jump/slide/dodge, obstacles, rewards, etc.
Web browser based game. No Login. No leaderboard.
Keep track of token usage and total time spent building the game.
Do not stop until it passes all tests and is ready to release.

run.scope: observed session: first user prompt to final assistant response

static_delivery.reason: Unbundled ES modules and CSS; no build step required. Runtime validated by common browser smoke.

restricted_storage.scenario: localStorage getter throws, representing denied browser storage

implementation.renderer: Canvas 2D with procedural perspective projection; JavaScript; zero npm dependencies
implementation.simulation: Variable render delta capped at 50 ms; Math.random in runtime; pure helper functions tested separately
features: Three lanes, jump/slide/dodge, three obstacle types
Energy orbs and bonus orbs, distance score, speed ramp
Keyboard, swipes, tap to jump, on-screen touch buttons
Start, pause/resume, game-over/retry, locally stored best score
optional_absent: No procedural audio or mute control
No shield/magnet/boost power-ups; bonus orbs are score rewards
No seeded replay or title autopilot
No automatic pause on hidden tab or blur
No guard when localStorage access throws
defects: Restricted-storage bootstrap throws an uncaught error (reproduced).
Score HUD/best update happens after collision handling; endRun returns before updating HUD, so the old HUD may remain on death (source observation, manual severity unassessed).

metric_definitions.total_tokens: input_tokens_including_cache + output_tokens; includes repeated cache reads; observed assistant requests only
metric_definitions.loc_production: All physical lines including comments/blanks in src code, index.html and root style.css; excludes tests, dependency/generated code, package locks and tooling/config
metric_definitions.wall_clock_build_seconds: Observed session duration, human prompt to final assistant message; not self-reported release-ready checkpoint

fairness_limitations: One run per model; no statistical performance or quality conclusions.
Same normalized prompt and logged high effort; initial API context size, chosen stack/dependencies, tool usage and validation strategy differ.
Claude Desktop 2.1.284 on one host is recorded; original system prompt parity, model internals and hardware/load are unverified. Opus 5.5 explicitly invokes a browser skill.
Original Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 sessions overlap in wall time, so contention is possible.
Session timing includes setup, tests, browser QA and final narration; author checkpoints use different endpoints.
Aggregate token counts include repeated cached context, unlike the repositories context-growth reports; not a monetary cost estimate or complete invoice.
Authored test counts and scope are unequal. Common smoke tests improve comparability without asserting equal correctness.
Canvas versus WebGL, software renderer behavior, adaptive graphics and device/browser differences can change visual/performance results. No FPS ranking is inferred.
Native first attempts include an incomplete Sonnet 5.5 timeout and an invalid Opus 5.5 shared-port result; all retained and labeled.
Raw in-game scores, speed units, health and obstacle generation differ. Equal seed numbers do not generate equal tracks; only two games honor URL seeds.
Google Fonts in Sonnet 5 adds a network dependency; other games bundle fonts or draw without them.
No committed baseline is available; exact cumulative created/changed counts cannot be reconstructed reliably.
Gameplay MP4s are absent. Final audio/video decoding, timing alignment and manual gameplay reviews are deferred until originals are supplied.
